original_criteria_unchanged.criterion: Distinguish gross iodine production from surviving iodine inventory.
Compare sink exhaustion and precursor consumption, not colour onset alone.

forecast: A larger thiosulfate sink can delay iodine accumulation even if the underlying iodine-production kinetics are similar.
scope: Inspect gross source vs surviving iodine, distinct sink loss routes, remaining sink and peroxide precursor at matched times. No observed induction time; both sinks unexhausted at100s, forecast unconfirmed. No empirical kinetic/optical calibration.
